args.sql:
SELECT 
    d.makername AS manufacturer,
    d.modnum AS model,
    ts.devscope AS device_type,
    r.rgbbright AS rgb_brightness,
    r.rgbcoloracc AS color_accuracy,
    r.rgbzones AS number_of_rgb_zones,
    r.rgbmodes AS rgb_modes,
    r.rgbcolors AS supported_colors,
    -- Calculate RGB Implementation Quality Score
    (
        r.rgbbright * 0.2 + 
        r.rgbcoloracc * 0.3 + 
        r.rgbzones * 0.15 + 
        r.rgbmodes * 0.15 + 
        r.rgbcolors * 0.2
    ) AS rgb_implementation_quality_score,
    -- Classify RGB Quality based on the calculated score
    CASE
        WHEN (r.rgbbright * 0.2 + r.rgbcoloracc * 0.3 + r.rgbzones * 0.15 + r.rgbmodes * 0.15 + r.rgbcolors * 0.2) > 8.0 THEN 'Premium RGB Implementation'
        WHEN (r.rgbbright * 0.2 + r.rgbcoloracc * 0.3 + r.rgbzones * 0.15 + r.rgbmodes * 0.15 + r.rgbcolors * 0.2) BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.0 THEN 'High-Quality RGB'
        WHEN (r.rgbbright * 0.2 + r.rgbcoloracc * 0.3 + r.rgbzones * 0.15 + r.rgbmodes * 0.15 + r.rgbcolors * 0.2) BETWEEN 3.0 AND 5.9 THEN 'Standard RGB'
        ELSE 'Basic RGB'
    END AS rgb_classification
FROM 
    deviceidentity d
JOIN 
    testsessions ts ON d.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
JOIN 
    rgb r ON d.devregistry = r.rgbregistry
ORDER BY 
    rgb_implementation_quality_score DESC;
